$comment: The 10th authored source. A ROLE is what a control MEANS; a treatment is how that meaning gets painted. Widgets bind to ROLES and never to treatments — that indirection is what makes the whole app re-dressable from data, and it is what stops 'neubrutalist' being written into a widget helper. Per-surface, with per-role fallback to `default` (the same M2 rule the matrix uses), so a surface states only what it CHANGES. A role may pin its own `tone`: danger is coral on every surface, because 'are you sure you want to delete this' must not turn lime just because the hub's tone is lime.
